ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 / OceanLotus DLL side-loading via signed AV binary executed from non-install path
ucs.description: Hunts APT32's signature delivery pattern: a legitimately signed third-party EXE (McAfee mcods/McUtil, Symantec RasTls, Avast wsc_proxy, Trend TmDbgLog, Adobe AcroTranscoder, or Vietnamese-AV BkavAuto/HappyTimer) executing from %APPDATA%, %ProgramData%, %TEMP% or other non-install directories so it side-loads a co-located malicious DLL that loads the Denis / SOUNDBITE / KOMPROGO / Cobalt Strike beacon. This signed-binary + odd-path combination has been documented across OceanLotus / Cobalt Kitty / BISMUTH intrusions for years and is rarely seen outside their tradecraft.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("mcods.exe","McUtil.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","rastls.exe","AcroTranscoder.exe","HappyTimer.exe","BkavAuto.exe","mcvsshld.exe","TmDbgLog.exe","AAM Updates Notifier.exe") AND NOT (Processes.process_path="*\\Program Files\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Program Files (x86)\\*" OR Processes.process_path="C:\\Windows\\*") by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename firstTime as first_seen, lastTime as last_seen | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
// APT32 / OceanLotus side-loading: legit signed AV/utility EXE executed from non-install path
let KnownAbusedBinaries = dynamic(["mcods.exe","mcutil.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","rastls.exe","acrotranscoder.exe","happytimer.exe","bkavauto.exe","mcvsshld.exe","tmdbglog.exe","aam updates notifier.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where tolower(FileName) in (KnownAbusedBinaries)
| where not(FolderPath startswith_cs @"C:\Program Files\")
| where not(FolderPath startswith_cs @"C:\Program Files (x86)\")
| where not(FolderPath startswith_cs @"C:\Windows\")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("mcods.exe","McUtil.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","rastls.exe","AcroTranscoder.exe","HappyTimer.exe","BkavAuto.exe")
    | project DeviceId, SideloadedDll = FileName, SideloadedDllPath = FolderPath, DllSHA256 = SHA256, Timestamp
  ) on DeviceId
| where SideloadedDllPath == FolderPath  // companion DLL in same dir = side-load
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
          ProcessCommandLine, SideloadedDll, DllSHA256,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Sentinel port — Windows Security 4688 + ASIM, no DeviceImageLoad equivalent so we alert on the binary-from-odd-path half
let KnownAbusedBinaries = dynamic(["mcods.exe","mcutil.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","rastls.exe","acrotranscoder.exe","happytimer.exe","bkavauto.exe","mcvsshld.exe","tmdbglog.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ImageLower = tolower(NewProcessName)
| extend LeafName = tostring(split(ImageLower, "\\")[-1])
| where LeafName in (KnownAbusedBinaries)
| where not(ImageLower startswith @"c:\program files\")
| where not(ImageLower startswith @"c:\program files (x86)\")
| where not(ImageLower startswith @"c:\windows\")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc

date: 2026/06/17

  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005

logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mcods.exe'
      - '\McUtil.exe'
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\rastls.exe'
      - '\AcroTranscoder.exe'
      - '\HappyTimer.exe'
      - '\BkavAuto.exe'
      - '\mcvsshld.exe'
      - '\TmDbgLog.exe'

    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\'

  - Standalone-portable installs of legitimate AV utilities (rare in enterprise)

level: high

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(mcods|mcutil|wsc_proxy|rastls|acrotranscoder|happytimer|bkavauto|mcvsshld|tmdbglog)\.exe$/i

ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 mshta.exe HTA/CACTUSTORCH execution from Office or browser parent
ucs.description: Detects the APT32 / OceanLotus / Canvas Cyclone phishing chain in which a weaponised lure (Word/Excel/Outlook attachment or browser download) spawns mshta.exe to execute remote/inline HTA, JScript, or VBScript — including the CACTUSTORCH-style DotNetToJScript pattern used to in-memory-load .NET assemblies (Cobalt Strike beacons, Denis, SOUNDBITE).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe") AND Processes.process_name="mshta.exe" AND (Processes.process="*.hta*" OR Processes.process="*javascript:*" OR Processes.process="*vbscript:*" OR Processes.process="*http://*" OR Processes.process="*https://*" OR Processes.process="*ActiveXObject*" OR Processes.process="*DotNetToJScript*" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*System.Reflection*") by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename firstTime as first_seen, lastTime as last_seen | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
// APT32 / OceanLotus CACTUSTORCH-style mshta chain off an Office or browser parent
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe")
| where FileName =~ "mshta.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".hta","javascript:","vbscript:","http://","https://","ActiveXObject","DotNetToJScript","FromBase64String","System.Reflection","GetObject(")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentLower = tolower(ParentProcessName), ChildLower = tolower(NewProcessName)
| where ParentLower matches regex @"\\(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|msedge|chrome|firefox|iexplore)\.exe$"
| where ChildLower endswith @"\mshta.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any (".hta","javascript:","vbscript:","http://","https://","ActiveXObject","DotNetToJScript","FromBase64String","System.Reflection")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
